messages:
Sally Chen: Quick heads-up — ran the nightly audit-coverage scan and assembled a gap map across services. Some high-risk omissions we should triage before the compliance review next month.

Sally Chen: Short summary: missing events by service -> api-gateway: request_denied, header_mutation; auth: role_change, token_refresh, rbac_policy_update; console: impersonation_start, impersonation_end; billing: invoice_download, billing_role_grant; runtime: model_fallback, kv_cache_eviction. :eyes:

AJ Patel: can you paste the raw list and your suggested priority? I can pull into the sprint board.

Sally Chen: pasted below — I marked P0/P1/P2. P0 = required for SOC2/PCI customers, P1 = strongly recommended, P2 = backlog.

```
P0: auth.role_change, api_gateway.request_denied, runtime.model_fallback
P1: auth.token_refresh, console.impersonation_start, billing.invoice_download
P2: api_gateway.header_mutation, console.impersonation_end, billing.billing_role_grant, runtime.kv_cache_eviction
```

Marco Ruiz: Agree with P0. runtime.model_fallback is actually causing silent degradations. We need event fields that capture: model_id, fallback_reason, latency_ms, request_id.

Sally Chen: good call. Proposed schema snippet for model_fallback event:

```
event: model_fallback
service: runtime
actor: runtime-service
resource: /models/:model_id
attrs:
  - model_id
  - fallback_to_model_id
  - reason
  - latency_ms
  - request_id
```

Priya Narang: For auth.role_change we also need previous_role and new_role, and who initiated (user vs system). Also include a change_token for idempotency.

AJ Patel: Who picks owners? I can assign org tickets if we decide P0 now. I can take api-gateway and help coordinate with runtime.

Sally Chen: I'll own auth.role_change and console.impersonation. Marco -> runtime.model_fallback + kv_cache_eviction. Priya -> billing.invoice_download and billing_role_grant. AJ -> api-gateway items. I'll create tickets and link to the compliance checklist.

DevSec Bot: New ticket created: #SEC-4821 "auth.role_change audit event" (assigned to Sally Chen)

AJ Patel: ETA for P0 fixes? If we want in next sprint, we need PRs by end of week for schema + a small shim to send events.

Sally Chen: Targeting PRs by Thu EOD for auth + api-gateway. Marco aims Thu for runtime schema, may need extra cycle for the runtime integration test.

Priya Narang: I'll draft the customer-facing event validation docs after tickets land — short JSON examples and contract validations. Can we standardize timestamp as ISO8601 and include event_version?

Sally Chen: yes — event_version + iso_ts required. Also add sampling_hint and retention_policy fields if applicable.

Marco Ruiz: One more: for billing.invoice_download we should include obfuscated_user_id to avoid PII in logs.

AJ Patel: ok. I'll create the sprint tickets and link this thread. Everyone add acceptance criteria to the ticket: schema, unit test, integration smoke, and docs. :thumbsup:

Sally Chen: thanks all. I'll post the backlog rollup in the compliance board and ping legal for a quick review of billing events. Follow-ups: 1) tickets created by EOD 2) PRs for P0 by Thu EOD 3) Priya drafts public validation samples.

DevSec Bot: Reminder: compliance review meeting scheduled in 7 days.
